open_points.subject: post-anonymisation project-create replay
open_points.text: R0-36 says “a create repeated after that is a new create, and its answer shows the new record it made,” while A01 rule 8 says it is “checked as any create” and a currently restricted, ended or erased customer refuses it, with a new record answered only “when accepted.”
open_points.question: After anonymisation removes the original request id, is repeating the create guaranteed to make and return a new record, or may current create refusal conditions prevent it?
options: Always create and return a new record as R0-36 states
Treat it as an ordinary new create and refuse it when any current create precondition fails, as A01 rule 8 states
open_points.default_guess: Follow the newer A01 rule 8: treat it as an ordinary new create subject to all current refusal conditions.

witness.initial: Active project P was created with request id K and names customer C.
events: The owner anonymises P, removing P's request id K.
The owner repeats the original create with request id K and customer C.
outcomes: R0-36 requires a new project to be made and returned.
A01 rule 8 refuses the create because C is now restricted, making no project.
witness.observer: The owner receives either a new project or a refusal.
